obligations.statement: The dispenser must be mountable on a wall.
derivation_premises: A wall-mounted product must have a mounting interface that can be attached to a vertical surface.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must hold approximately twenty items.
derivation_premises: A container must have internal volume sufficient to accommodate the stated number of items.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must release exactly one item per lever press.
derivation_premises: To release exactly one item, the mechanism must have a motion path that isolates a single item and prevents multiple from being dispensed.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must allow refilling from the top without removal from the wall.
derivation_premises: A top opening must be accessible from above while the dispenser is fixed to the wall.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must operate without jamming when nearly empty.
derivation_premises: Jamming occurs when a mechanism's moving parts are obstructed; thus the mechanism must maintain clear motion paths even with minimal load.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must support the weight of approximately twenty items.
derivation_premises: A container holding items must be able to support their gravitational load without failure.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must withstand the force applied by the user when pressing the lever.
derivation_premises: An external force on the lever must be transmitted through the structure without failure.
